s/b. as unit 1 entered the intersection, unit 2 entered the intersection unlawfully on a red signal, stopping as he crossed into the crosswalk area. due to unit 2 entering unit 1's path of travel/path of turn, unit 1 struck unit 2 in the front left to front right of unit 2 (based on the video, it appears that unit 1 would have cleared the intersection properly if unit 2 had not entered the intersection and into her path unlawfully). unit 1 driver then put the vehicle in reverse and hit the gas. unit 1 backed in a clockwise path and crashed into the wooden fence at [roadway] [roadway] forward in a counterclockwise path back towards unit 2 and impacts unit 2 on the right passenger side of the vehicle. unit 1 then puts the vehicle back in reverse and reverses in a clockwise path and crashes into the fence again. unit 3 (pedestrian / previous driver of unit 2) had gotten out of the vehicle and began to approach unit 1 as it was backed into the fence area and had reached the fence area where unit 1 had crashed into, unit 1 [roadway] forward and struck unit 3, causing him to fall down and be run over by the left tires of the vehicle (in the leg area- unit 3 was ambulatory on scene and refused transport). unit 1 then continued and struck unit 2's rear passenger quarter panel, unit 4's front right, which caused unit 4's rear right to strike unit 5's front left. dash camera footage was provided by nathanial gregorier [phone]. additional footage from a tesla was viewed (cell phone recording of tesla dash camera footage- homeowner displayed video- amber-[phone], owner of footage, sonya [phone]). the driver of unit 1 is elderly, and her age may have contributed to the panic following the initial collision and additional collisions that resulted. det. berrettini recommends a medical review board for unit 1 driver. videos retained in evidence. com.
